verdict.rationale: First-party docs state you can add React to an existing HTML page and render components anywhere without rewriting (react-docs-1, react-docs-12), using createRoot on any DOM node (react-docs-8). The README says 'you can use as little or as much React as you need' (react-gh-3), and the docs point to full-stack frameworks like Next.js and React Router for building entire apps (react-docs-4, react-docs-21), covering the scale from a page fragment to a full application. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the incremental-adoption path.
